title: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance…
content: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 prompt to turn an idea into a structured storyboard and then a Seedance-ready prompt.
tips: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 prompt to turn an idea into a structured storyboard and then a Seedance-ready prompt.

es.content: Usa un flujo de trabajo de Imagen/Concepto → storyboard de Custom GPT Image 2.0 → prompt de Seedance 2.5 para convertir una idea en un storyboard estructurado y luego en un prompt listo para Seedance.

fr.content: Utilisez un workflow allant de Image/Concept → storyboard Custom GPT Image 2.0 → prompt Seedance 2.5 pour transformer une idée en storyboard structuré, puis en un prompt prêt pour Seedance.

ja.content: Image/Concept → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 prompt というワークフローを使って、アイデアを構造化されたストーリーボードに落とし込み、さらに Seedance で使える prompt に変換します。

ko.content: 이미지/컨셉 → Custom GPT Image 2.0 스토리보드 → Seedance 2.5 prompt 워크플로를 사용해 아이디어를 구조화된 스토리보드로 만든 다음, Seedance에 바로 사용할 수 있는 prompt로 변환하세요.

pt.content: Use um fluxo de trabalho de Image/Concept → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 prompt para transformar uma ideia em um storyboard estruturado e, em seguida, em um prompt pronto para o Seedance.

zh.content: 使用 Image/Concept → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 prompt 的工作流程，将一个创意转化为结构化分镜，然后生成可直接用于 Seedance 的 prompt。
